summary: Round 2, tests. The round-1 major is closed and MEASURED closed: the new at-cap assertion in aCROSSAZBatchABOVETheInlineCapIsNotINLINED kills both surviving mutations, each on its own. Eight mutations of FetchPolicy.modeFor run against :ingest:test (207 tests), all killed, no survivor found. The backlog State cell's corrected wording about the ordering case is accurate. No existing assertion was weakened; the test-file hunk is pure addition.
